boxes.meaning: friend; person you spend time with

english.meaning: friend; person you spend time with
english.note: Use 同伴 as the all-purpose noun for a person who accompanies you or spends time with you.

examples.english: My companion went to the cinema with me today.
examples.traditional: 我同伴今日陪我去睇戲。
